review: First reasoned review of selector-cipher, Elex resource stager and VIP Recovery
method: Static analysis only; no specimen code or network payload was executed. Facts and initial/final atomscan reports are in scratch/review-fallout.

evidence: Parsed the source as data; converted U+FE00..FE0F and U+E0100..E01EF to byte values. Decrypted AES-256-CBC with the embedded key/IV and removed PKCS7 padding without executing the result.
The plaintext sleeps, issues getSignaturesForAddress to Solana RPC, selects a transaction memo, JSON-parses it and Base64-decodes its link field to select the next host.

The next HTTP request includes platform.system() as its os header; the response body is Base64-decoded and passed directly to exec. Header-provided secretkey and ivbase64 become variables visible to that executed code.
samples.traits: Both Unicode concealment composites remain accurate at suspicious. A harmless encrypted greeting meets the same outer pattern, so the outer representation alone cannot justify hostile severity.
samples.limitation: The analyzer does not automatically recover this AES/variation-selector stage. The extracted stage separately receives signature-memo-decoded-evaluation; its remote response was not fetched.

evidence: The EXE is unsigned and declares Microsoft IMGUTIL.DLL metadata despite not having the DLL characteristic.
The startup path reaches 0x402596, optionally stages a self-copy using 0x401c9f and its ping-delayed WinExec command, then calls 0x40206c.

0x40206c loads REGISTRY resource 149 (172032 bytes). The loop at 0x402143 subtracts repeating keys (first+second, second, first), modulo 256. Initial keys are 0x6c and 0xaa. The writer restores the first two bytes to MZ.

The recovered PE is a DLL exporting Interface. The stub writes it into a random Program Files directory, sets that directory attribute to 2 (hidden), copies system32/rundll32.exe into the directory under a random .exe name, and CreateProcessA launches the copied executable with the DLL Interface export.
The noise-path finding was caused by five semicolon-separated PATH entries in appended environment blocks, not deliberate noise padding.
samples.traits: Require the distinctive Elex naming alphabet for family attribution; remove generic vendor-plus-entropy spoofing; retain the explicit DLL disguise/resource/launch evidence. High entropy/nonstandard sections remain suspicious rather than proving a packed Trojan.
samples.limitation: The recovered DLL has a further packed .KJ1 layer. No mining or ransomware behavior is established by this review.

evidence: Decoded CLR metadata and disassembled all method bodies with dnfile/dncil, resolving MemberRef/MethodDef/Field/user-string tokens. Entry token is 0x060000aa (COVID19.Main).

Main directly invokes browser credential collectors plus Outlook, Foxmail, FileZilla, Pidgin and Firefox-family collectors before AntiBotStart. FileZilla loads recentservers.xml, extracts Host/User/Pass/Port, decodes the password and appends the resulting account report to StoragePW.

VIPSeassion.GetMasterKey reads Local State, decodes encrypted_key, removes the five-byte DPAPI prefix and calls ProtectedData.Unprotect. Card collectors read credit_cards and card_number_encrypted and recover encrypted values before appending card records.

AntiBotStart calls Once_PW_Sender and Once_CreditCard_Sender when their collection flags allow. The configured SMTP branch assigns StoragePW to MailMessage.Body and calls SmtpClient.Send. Offline DES-ECB configuration decryption uses MD5(passphrase)[0:8]; the recovered server is hosting2.ro.hostsailor.com on port 587.

The keylogger constructor calls P/Invoke SetHook with WH_KEYBOARD_LL=13. ProcessKey translates keys, raises events, and hook_KeyDown appends text/window captions to keylogs. KeyboardSender can place keylogs in an SMTP message. Native import absence does not mean the hook APIs are dynamically resolved.

isSMTP is True. isTelegram and its token/chat identifiers remain builder placeholders; a claim that this build sends cookies through Telegram is unsupported. Several named features, including VM checks, Defender disabling and the Collected_Keyboard startup helper, have no-op method bodies. StartKeylogger is not called by the entry path.
samples.traits: Require keystroke-report evidence for hook recording and input-delivery profiles; describe available APIs rather than claiming all are configured. Replace path-only card theft with encrypted-column/read/DPAPI context. Multi-client store access is suspicious rather than certain theft. Remove generic RedLine and Thunderbird identity claims.
samples.limitation: The hook recording/delivery traits describe included capabilities, not a claim that this build enables keylogging at startup. The malicious verdict rests on reachable credential acquisition and configured SMTP transmission.

checks.family_near_miss: Replacing only the Elex naming alphabet removes Elex attribution while retaining the resource-disguise loader detection.

taxonomy_decisions: Deleted unsupported co-occurrence claims rather than reclassifying generic content as intent. Existing vendor, resource-entropy and store-path atoms retain their observations.
GetBrowsers substring matching now lives under metadata/binary/symbols/name and explicitly describes a name fragment; it also matches GetBrowsersEmpty and is not a RedLine fingerprint.

The broad Thunderbird name-only identity was removed. The neutral target leaf is at its rule budget, so no new duplicate name observation was added. Existing structured Thunderbird product/signature identity rules remain.
